mission: Navego pays for itself and for the agent that keeps it alive: real customers, real charges, every cost named with a payer.

revenue.verified_by: opera_price_orders = 0 rows; opera_notification_log accepted rows are Midtrans sandbox events only; no PayPal live settlement has been recorded (checked 2026-11-25).

next_action: Land and deploy PR #442 so one completed live PayPal order writes a paypal-live settlement row before plan activation, then prove that row against the production order id.

leak_found_2.what: The deployed Supabase Auth config named only dead predecessor hosts (site_url on the retired product domain, allow-list on the retired deployment), so the consent page on the live domain got 400 'unauthorized request origin' and pairing died at the approval step - the funnel's wall between 15 pair views and 1 install view.
leak_found_2.proof: owner console capture 2026-11-24 (the oauth consent endpoint answered 400 unauthorized request origin); CI read run 45373897531 printed the predecessor site_url and an allow-list without navego.pages.dev.
leak_found_2.fix: CI workflow .github/workflows/auth-config.yml (PRs #436, #437, #438, #439) patched production: site_url=https://navego.pages.dev and uri_allow_list gained https://navego.pages.dev/*, verified from run 45376655642 log; pinned by decisions.json -> hosted-consent-origin-01.

paypal_revenue_gap.what: A completed PayPal order activated a Navego plan but wrote no settled sale, so a real payment could leave the economy ledger and the automation score unchanged.
paypal_revenue_gap.proof: live production query 2026-11-24: opera_price_orders held 0 rows, opera_notification_log held only Midtrans sandbox events, and opera_plan_activate_purchase changed plans without recording a PayPal order.
paypal_revenue_gap.fix: hosted/functions/_shared/paypal.ts and hosted/functions/navego-billing/index.ts record the completed USD order in opera_notification_log before activation; pinned by decisions.json -> hosted-paypal-revenue-01.

leak_found.what: wallet.deposit has no active row in opera_price_list on the live project, so openTopUp invoices price 'not charged: no price for this kind' (Rp 0) — a buyer cannot pay even after clicking buy.
leak_found.proof: live invoice 1ec02bc3-7c1b-45a2-b864-837e95ba3b24:wallet-mwuhd3km created 2026-11-24 rendered 'not charged: no price for this kind'; public price list at functions/v1/navego-billing?prices=1 lists only task.* kinds; wallet migration 20261104120000 carries the row (1,000,000 sen IDR) but it was never applied to the live price table.
